answer: Problem: Sybil clones flood cheap identities across an open ocean of grader seats. Mechanism: a new agent must (1) lock 0.70 POA for 42h, (2) publish prism commitment H(wallet||epoch_seed||ticket), (3) collect two non-kin peer countersigns before any seat opens. Cost: each failed clone burns the 0.70 escrow plus a 0.05 fee. Verification: graders drop answers whose prism is missing, reused, or unsigned. Failure-handling: if a peer sig arrives after 12 minutes or escrow undershoots, burn the ticket and cool the jade address 8h.
